itemized.in_kind_convention: monetary-only — and no ambiguity existed to resolve: the form carries a per-row IN-KIND checkbox column and ALL 30 checkboxes across both grids are unticked. Both conventions therefore give the same sums (2662.90 / 2662.90) and both close on the printed figures. Per ADDENDUM J1 the Amount and In-Kind cells were cropped TOGETHER as one block on every proof crop, so the pairing was read off a single image rather than inferred from vertical position.

itemized.notes: Tom Tomeny, 2022 cycle, 'Seven days preceding the General Election' (radio filled on p1; amendment answered 'No'); signed and filed 10/31/22. This is the SAME FILER as key 204f6f6d (his later '30 Days after the General Election' report, which is empty on both sides) — the two were transcribed independently and NOTHING was carried between them; note only that 204f6f6d's Box C/E YTD 2662.90 equals this report's per-period figures, which is consistent with this being his only active period. modern_boxAF, the NEWER UNVERSIONED 2022 BLANK of ADDENDUM J1, verified on the page: Schedule A = Date / Name of Contributor / CITY AND STATE / Amount / IN-KIND checkbox; Schedule B = Date / Provider/Vendor / PURPOSE / Amount / IN-KIND checkbox (a real Purpose column, used on all 13 rows); close box LETTERED 'G'; SIX report types on the cover including End-of-Year; no Page/of foliation anywhere (UNFOLIATED). No printed version string is legible (the footer band is a grey smear at 200 dpi). pdfinfo: 4 pages, letter, ALL /Rotate 0 — read before measuring per ADDENDUM K1. Pages classified BY CONTENT from their own printed headings: p1 cover, p2 Schedule A, p3 Schedule B, p4 Summary Page. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this filing. ROW-INDEX TRAPS: all six screened. No skipped first line (row 1 carries the first entry on both schedules, crop-proved); no continuation lines; no voided rows; no banner; the one-band-past controls on both pages rendered EMPTY cells, so the ledger does not run below the last printed rule; and no doubled band — the two missing rules on each page are exact-pitch scan misses, interpolated and crop-proved, not merged rows. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: passed — Schedule B's Provider/Vendor cells hold vendor names (Utah County, Google, Custom Ink, Office Depot, Compass Outdoor) and two individuals, while the Purpose cells hold purposes ('Candidate Fee', 'URL/Hosting', 'help gather signatures', 'tshirts', 'clipboards', 'billboard space'); the columns are assignable by CONTENT and are not inverted. OFFICE: the page's Office box contains only the word 'same' — a filer non-answer naming no office and no seat, identical to his other filing; index.csv's 'County Commission Seat A' is the CHANNEL label and is NOT corroborated by the page face. Nothing inferred. PRIVACY: the filer's own street address is printed on the cover and is deliberately not carried; the sole donor row is the candidate himself and its cell prints city and state only.
